candidates.title: Medchal head constable accused of assaulting motorist
candidates.excerpt: A head constable attached to the Medchal traffic police station allegedly slapped a motorist during a drunk-driving check. A video of the incident went viral, drawing criticism online. The motorist alleged that the officer also seized his vehicle and verbally abused him.

candidates.title: Two Sangareddy Residents Die in Karnataka Road Accident
candidates.excerpt: According to reports, the deceased were residents of Manoor in Sangareddy district of Telangana. The injured were immediately shifted to a hospital for treatment.

candidates.title: ZFD initiative: Sangareddy Collector, SP survey accident-prone stretches on NH-65
candidates.excerpt: As part of the Centre's Zero Fatality District (ZFD) programme, Sangareddy Collector Prateek Jain and Superintendent of Police Paritosh Pankaj inspected accident-prone stretches of NH-65 from Patancheru to Digwal near Zaheerabad.
